citation: Yeh, I. (1998). Concrete Compressive Strength. UCI. DOI 10.24432/C5PK67.
split_rule: Group by first seven source inputs encoded as little-endian float64. SHA256 group bytes, then sort groups by SHA256(arena16.12/split/ + group hex). First floor(0.7G) train, next through floor(0.85G) explain, remainder audit. Preserve every row, sort row ids within split.

model_recipe.normalization: train-only population mean and standard deviation; folded into raw-input/raw-MPa states

background_order_rule: SHA256(arena16.14/background/{seed}/{source_row}), lexicographic digest order of training rows only.

query_order.rule: All explanation rows in ascending pinned source-ID order, then all audit rows in ascending pinned source-ID order.

known_16_14_evidence.model_state_hash_rule: SHA256 over sorted parameter names; for each, prefix uint64-le byte length of compact sorted-key JSON {dtype,name,shape}, then C-order little-endian tensor bytes.

reuse_scope: Reproduce the exact known 16.14/16.15 seeded predictors and donor games on the same pinned Concrete data. This is not an independent model or dataset replication.

interaction_design_candidate.note: Candidate values require independent protocol review and freeze before native execution.

random_exact.iteration_order: n_players 3..7 outer, replicate 0..2 inner; one standard_normal(2**n_players) float64 call assigned to ascending mask IDs
random_exact.game_tensor_hash_rule: tensor_mapping_sha256 under key values, separately per listed game

within_size_shuffle.iteration_order: replicate 0..127 outer; audit source IDs in pinned order; coalition sizes 1..7; one permutation of ascending mask IDs at each size; assignment shuffled_value[mask]=value[permutation[mask]]; masks 0 and 255 fixed

random_pair_order.iteration_order: replicate 0..255; one permutation of lexicographic pair row IDs 0..27

rng_contract.derived_seed_hex_semantics: 32 lowercase zero-padded hexadecimal digits representing the resulting little-endian integer; this is generally byte-reversed relative to digest[:16].hex()

fixed_exact_games.mask_order: ascending integer mask; bit i is player i

control_labels.mixed_degree2: degree-at-most-two agreement and exact-reconstruction control; it is not an additive zero-pair game

reference_scope_candidate.direct_shapiq_scope: all exact and all 2992 empirical games; direct ExactComputer per game
reference_scope_candidate.timing_policy: measured timing leaves are removed from deterministic payloads and retained only in timings.pt

nearest_training_contract.query_scope: all 272 rows x all 256 masks x first 8 primary donors
nearest_training_contract.standardization: train-only float64 population mean and standard deviation
nearest_training_contract.distance: for each feature in index order compute squared float64 difference, sum over 8 features in index order, then sqrt
nearest_training_contract.tie_rule: among rows whose computed distance equals the minimum exactly, return the smallest source ID

physical_hybrid_shards.rehash_policy: before and after every shallow replacement, hash tensor values and final artifact bytes; recursive leaf manifest records every descriptor and nonexternal leaf

retained_payload_contract.expansion_rule: Every listed path is required. Reference instances expand the complete reference_result_tensor_template with the instance n_players, order, and games. No unlisted outcome may replace a required leaf.
